commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+1' Alex Berenguer comes off the pitch to be replaced by Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao).
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
89' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
88' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to substitute Jose Angel Carmona and he is replaced by Stanis Idumbo (Sevilla).

84' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Alex Berenguer flights the free kick into the box, where Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao) peels off his marker and heads it straight into the bottom right corner from the edge of the six-yard box. He makes it 0:1.
84' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) is cautioned by the referee.
83' The referee allows time for a substitution. Djibril Sow will be replaced by Akor Adams (Sevilla).
83' Ath Bilbao failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
80' One of the players from Ath Bilbao times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
79' The resulting corner, taken by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao), comes to nothing.
76' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
75' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot, but is thwarted by a decent save from Orjan Nyland.
72' Great chance! Djibril Sow (Sevilla) picks up a rebound inside the box, cuts inside his marker but rifles his shot high over the bar.
70' Today's match ends for Gorka Guruzeta who will be replaced by Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao).
67' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) replacing Chidera Ejuke.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) comes onto the pitch for Isaac Romero.
65' Unai Nunez (Ath Bilbao) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
64' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
63' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
63' A pass into the penalty area from Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) is intercepted by the defence.
60' Ernesto Valverde prepares a substitution. Unai Gomez is replaced by Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao).
60' We are about to witness a subsitution. Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) for Mikel Vesga.
60' Ernesto Valverde decides to make a substitution. Benat Prados Diaz will be replaced by Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao).
59' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
59' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Unai Simon has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
56' A pass into the box finds Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) unmarked. He carefully places a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Unai Simon denies him.
53' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
53' None of the Ath Bilbao players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
53' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
50' Juan Pulido blows his whistle for a foul after Unai Nunez (Ath Bilbao) hacks down one of his opponents. There is a free kick near the sideline to Sevilla.
49' Unai Nunez (Ath Bilbao) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. A free kick has been awarded to Sevilla.

47' Nice individual effort by Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla). He gets all the way through to the keeper and hits a low drive to the middle of the goal, but Unai Simon does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out.
46' It will be a substitution. Albert Sambi Lokonga (Sevilla) is ready to enter the pitch as Saul Niguez walks off.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+3' Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) steps up to the penalty spot. He attempts to confuse the goalkeeper by stopping in the middle of his run up and sends the ball to the bottom left corner, but Orjan Nyland keeps his cool to thwart him.
45+2' Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
45+2' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!

45' Play continues despite the shouts by some Ath Bilbao players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Juan Pulido interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
44' Surely that's handball by one of the Sevilla players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
44' The resulting set piece from Ath Bilbao is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
41' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
40' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
38' Ath Bilbao couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Orjan Nyland (Sevilla) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
37' A defender mistimes his tackle on the edge on the box and let's in Djibril Sow (Sevilla). It's a decent effort but his shot flies just wide of the right post.
33' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
32' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Orjan Nyland comes off his line to intercept.
30' Handball! A player from Ath Bilbao handled the ball. Sevilla will take a free kick.
27' Ball possession – 58:42.
26' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) picks up a long through ball, but Unai Simon deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
24' Ath Bilbao take a short corner kick.
23' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
22' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
20' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Ath Bilbao, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
19' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
19' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
17' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
15' The linesman points to the corner flag, Sevilla are going to take it.
15' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
14' It's a throw-in for Ath Bilbao.
10' Orjan Nyland (Sevilla) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
10' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Orjan Nyland (Sevilla). Ath Bilbao are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
10' Ath Bilbao will take a corner kick.
8' This shall not pass! Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
6' A long through ball into the box almost gives Isaac Romero (Sevilla) a good chance, but he loses out to one of the defenders.
4' Neat passing move from Sevilla in order to create new attacking opportunities.
3' The ball is out of play. Ath Bilbao will take a throw-in.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Sevilla will take the kick-off.
Juan Pulido got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
